notes.title: How Cropdeck did on announcement (and some progress update)
notes.notes:
First, a huge thank you to everyone who has wishlisted or shared my game! It has been an incredible two weeks since the Steam page launch, and I truly appreciate all your support.

🚜 First 291 Wishlists!
It may seem like an odd number (well, it literally is!), but 291 is how many gamers have wishlisted Cropdeck in its first two weeks on Steam! I’m so happy that you're interested in my game! This is my first solo project, and every wishlist, like, and comment means the world to me. 🙏

🌙 Steam Festival
I’m excited to announce that Cropdeck is part of The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025 on Steam! There are so many amazing new and upcoming games from Southeast Asia and beyond—including mine!

If you love cozy games and deckbuilders like me, you’ll find plenty of wonderful creations to explore. There are a lot of other categories too. Go check them out!

This is my first-ever Steam festival, and I’m sorry there’s no demo yet—but please be patient! I’m working hard to release the first playable demo in the coming months. If you don’t want to miss it, follow me on Bluesky, X, or Threads for updates.

🎨 Back to Work!!
The last two months were super busy for me, so I couldn’t focus as much on the game itself. Between setting up my Steam developer account, preparing the Steam page and marketing materials, taking a short holiday, going on a mountain trip, aaand fighting the flu (I’m all good now!)—a lot was happening.

But now, I’m back and fully committed to Cropdeck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/a65cd8f76b4ce6d2e6c2aa7c89fbe60b60a5b3ed.gif

I’ve started by updating the UI, especially the calendar and card feel. Scarecrows are now displayed above the fields, making them more visible and better connected to the game world. You can clearly see their effects now, and along with regular cards, they feel more alive thanks to subtle animations and mouse pointer interactions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/a067170d1e44181b68af618a1f54d09f4fade997.gif

The calendar has been completely reworked. It used to be a large widget that didn’t provide much useful info. Now, it works more like a progress bar, similar to those in other roguelike games. It sits at the top of the screen, giving you hints about upcoming events and weather conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/9d0b3507863c7d686f318d0beacf97f291874c81.gif

Speaking of weather... I’ve started working on the weather system! You’ll soon be able to plan your watering better by checking if rain is coming. Natural hazards (like the storms and ice cubes you saw in the trailer) will be part of this system too.

🎥 Follow Me on YouTube
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this post! If you’d like to stay updated, I’d love for you to follow me on socials. Today, I especially invite you to subscribe me on YouTube, as I’m preparing some new Shorts content in new format!
